content.short: Mantium has been designed to display your NFT collections in the most beautiful way, respecting their original format.
content.description: Mantiium is a new generation of Cardano Wallet. Build for NFT and DApps player. Images, Photos & Videos are supported by the Wallet. Mantium analyzes your transactions in real time, and determines if it is a send, a receive, NFT Mint, a staking gain. MinSwap, WingRiders, jpg.store... Mantium Wallet recognizes more than 50 addresses associated with DApps or smart contracts on the Cardano blockchain.
